title: 晶圓廠自動搬運系統
summary: 以 4 階段、24 個工程工作包拆解載具交握、尾端延遲、故障恢復，完成圖解、對照、敏感度分析、故障判別、量測規劃與驗收。
summaryEn: Four stages and 24 work packages explore carrier handshakes, tail latency and recovery through diagrams, comparisons, sensitivity studies, fault diagnosis, measurement plans and acceptance reviews.
scope: 依公開原理編寫的雙語概念實作課；每步交付可審查的工程證據。24 步是學習拆解，不代表晶圓廠的完整配方。自行設定的數值須標為假設。題目不含可直接操作的化學混配、設備設定或量產公差；照片與外部影片為代表媒體，不是假稱每步實拍。
scopeEn: Bilingual conceptual exercises based on public principles, with reviewable evidence at each step. The 24 steps are a learning decomposition, not a complete fab recipe. Chosen numerical inputs must be labeled hypothetical. No directly operable chemical mixtures, equipment settings or production tolerances are supplied. Photos and external videos are representative media, not claimed as recordings of every step.

stages.title: 搬運圖與產能
stages.description: 在「搬運圖與產能」建立六項互補證據，逐一檢查材料、幾何、物理機制與適用限制。
stages.descriptionEn: Build six complementary evidence items for transport graph and capacity, checking materials, geometry, mechanisms and validity limits.

steps.title: 辨識載具與批號
steps.objective: 完成「辨識載具與批號」的因果圖，把載具交握、尾端延遲、故障恢復中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete a causal diagram for identify carriers and lots, connecting relevant limits in carrier handshakes, tail latency and recovery to observable evidence.
steps.instruction: 本步問題：辨識載具與批號。畫一張含作用前後狀態的原創圖；以箭頭標出本步原理中的因果關係；圈出一項仍需量測的未知量。判讀依據：載具 ID 與晶圓批號不是同一資料欄位。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Identify carriers and lots. Draw an original before/after diagram; mark the causal relationship in this step; circle one quantity still requiring measurement. Interpretation: Carrier identity and wafer-lot identity are separate fields. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「載具 ID 與晶圓批號不是同一資料欄位。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
steps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Carrier identity and wafer-lot identity are separate fields. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
steps.failure: 常見錯判：平均車速較快就保證所有任務延遲下降。 應回到「辨識載具與批號」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: Higher mean speed guarantees lower delay for every task. Revisit assumptions and sampling for identify carriers and lots and add discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 交付「辨識載具與批號」因果圖：圖中要有邊界、輸入、輸出與一項不能僅由圖決定的量。
steps.checkEn: Submit the causal diagram for identify carriers and lots: Show boundaries, inputs, outputs and one quantity that the diagram alone cannot determine.

knowledge.title: 辨識載具與批號的原理
knowledge.text: 載具 ID 與晶圓批號不是同一資料欄位。
knowledge.textEn: Carrier identity and wafer-lot identity are separate fields.

knowledge.title: 本階段的機制與工程權衡
knowledge.text: 晶圓製程會反覆回到同類設備，搬運需求因此是有回路的網路問題，而非單向生產線的距離最小化。
knowledge.textEn: Wafers revisit equipment types, making transport a reentrant network problem rather than one-way line-distance minimization.

knowledge.title: 任務延伸｜接班建模：先寫出不能推論的事
knowledge.titleEn: Mission extension | Shift intake: state what the evidence cannot prove
knowledge.text:
以「晶圓廠自動搬運系統」為本次任務邊界，閱讀「辨識載具與批號」後，先列出輸入、輸出與量測單位。特別檢查：最快路徑不一定降低壅塞或縮短整體批次週期。將已知、模型假設與未量測項目分開，再進入「晶圓城夜班：來料、廠務與搬運」整合遊戲。

需留下的證據：任務邊界表：晶圓廠自動搬運系統 的資料版本、單位、輸入／輸出及一項不能由現有證據支持的結論。

驗證與交接：能用自己的話解釋為何「最快路徑不一定降低壅塞或縮短整體批次週期」，且沒有把猜測寫成實測。
knowledge.textEn:
Use Automated material handling in fabs as the task boundary. After reading “Identify carriers and lots”, list inputs, outputs and measurement units. Check specifically: The shortest route may not reduce congestion or total lot cycle time. Separate known data, model assumptions and unmeasured items before entering “Wafer City night shift: incoming material, utilities and logistics”.

Evidence to retain: Boundary sheet for Automated material handling in fabs: data version, units, inputs/outputs and one unsupported conclusion.

Verification and handover: Explain why “The shortest route may not reduce congestion or total lot cycle time” and do not present assumptions as measurements.

quiz.question: 評估「辨識載具與批號」時，哪項敘述可以採用？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is valid when evaluating identify carriers and lots?
options: 載具 ID 與晶圓批號不是同一資料欄位。
平均車速較快就保證所有任務延遲下降。
交握超時就代表載具尚未移動。
optionsEn: Carrier identity and wafer-lot identity are separate fields.
Higher mean speed guarantees lower delay for every task.
Handshake timeout means the carrier has not moved.
quiz.explanation: 載具 ID 與晶圓批號不是同一資料欄位。 晶圓製程會反覆回到同類設備，搬運需求因此是有回路的網路問題，而非單向生產線的距離最小化。
quiz.explanationEn: Carrier identity and wafer-lot identity are separate fields. Wafers revisit equipment types, making transport a reentrant network problem rather than one-way line-distance minimization.

steps.title: 建立有向路網
steps.objective: 完成「建立有向路網」的對照表，把載具交握、尾端延遲、故障恢復中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete a controlled comparison for build the directed route graph, connecting relevant limits in carrier handshakes, tail latency and recovery to observable evidence.
steps.instruction: 本步問題：建立有向路網。建立兩個只改一項條件的假想案例；分開記錄可觀察差異與推測原因；說明如何用本步原理區分兩者。判讀依據：單向軌道的可達性不能由直線距離判斷。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Build the directed route graph. Create two hypothetical cases differing in one condition; separate observations from proposed causes; use this step’s principle to distinguish them. Interpretation: Reachability on directed tracks differs from straight-line distance. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「單向軌道的可達性不能由直線距離判斷。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
steps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Reachability on directed tracks differs from straight-line distance. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
steps.failure: 常見錯判：平均車速較快就保證所有任務延遲下降。 應回到「建立有向路網」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: Higher mean speed guarantees lower delay for every task. Revisit assumptions and sampling for build the directed route graph and add discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 交付「建立有向路網」對照表：交出兩案例、固定條件、預期差異及一項可能混淆因素。
steps.checkEn: Submit the controlled comparison for build the directed route graph: Submit both cases, fixed conditions, predicted difference and one confounder.

steps.instruction: 本步問題：工具負載埠。選出本步的一項輸入及一項輸出；以自訂低、中、高三點畫趨勢；逐點標註假設，並寫出趨勢可能失效的條件。判讀依據：設備加工能力與載入埠容量需分開建模。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Represent load ports. Select one input and output for this step; sketch a hypothetical low/mid/high trend; label assumptions and state when the trend may fail. Interpretation: Process capacity and load-port capacity require separate models. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「設備加工能力與載入埠容量需分開建模。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。

steps.check: 交付「工具負載埠」敏感度草圖：圖須有變數、單位或無因次定義、三個假設點及適用範圍。
steps.checkEn: Submit the sensitivity sketch for represent load ports: Include variables, units or dimensionless definitions, three hypothetical points and validity limits.

steps.objectiveEn: Complete a fault-discrimination table for build a transport-demand matrix, connecting relevant limits in carrier handshakes, tail latency and recovery to observable evidence.
steps.instruction: 本步問題：搬運需求矩陣。假設本步預期結果未出現；提出兩個不同機制；為各機制選一個能支持或否定的觀察，避免只重複同一量測。判讀依據：製程回訪使晶圓不是只走一次單向流水線。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Build a transport-demand matrix. Assume the expected result fails; propose two distinct mechanisms; choose an observation that supports or rejects each rather than repeating one measurement. Interpretation: Reentrant processing makes wafer flow more than one pass down a line. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「製程回訪使晶圓不是只走一次單向流水線。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。

steps.check: 交付「搬運需求矩陣」故障判別表：至少列出兩個假說、各自的辨別證據及先檢查順序。
steps.checkEn: Submit the fault-discrimination table for build a transport-demand matrix: List two hypotheses, discriminating evidence for each and a check order.

steps.objectiveEn: Complete a measurement plan for allocate storage buffers, connecting relevant limits in carrier handshakes, tail latency and recovery to observable evidence.
steps.instruction: 本步問題：儲位與緩衝。針對本步定義待測量及採樣位置；列出解析度、背景與重複性；設計一個見證或空白，並說明檢出限如何限制結論。判讀依據：緩衝減少阻塞但增加在製品與等待。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Allocate storage buffers. Define the measurand and sampling locations; list resolution, background and repeatability; design a witness or blank and explain detection-limit constraints. Interpretation: Buffers reduce blocking but increase work in process and waiting. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「緩衝減少阻塞但增加在製品與等待。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。

steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan for allocate storage buffers: Provide sampling coordinates, units, controls and uncertainty sources.

steps.objectiveEn: Complete a engineering acceptance sheet for decompose transport time, connecting relevant limits in carrier handshakes, tail latency and recovery to observable evidence.
steps.instruction: 本步問題：搬運時間拆解。整合本步及本階段先前證據；提出兩項彼此不同的接受條件；再列一個會讓你暫緩放行的結果及下一個確認動作。判讀依據：等待、行車、升降與交握各有不同改善途徑。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Decompose transport time. Combine this step with earlier stage evidence; propose two independent acceptance criteria; name one hold condition and the next confirming action. Interpretation: Queueing, travel, hoisting and handshakes need different remedies. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「等待、行車、升降與交握各有不同改善途徑。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
steps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Queueing, travel, hoisting and handshakes need different remedies. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
steps.failure: 常見錯判：平均車速較快就保證所有任務延遲下降。 應回到「搬運時間拆解」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。

steps.check: 交付「搬運時間拆解」工程驗收單：驗收單需有原理、兩項證據、保留疑問及前後模組交接。
steps.checkEn: Submit the engineering acceptance sheet for decompose transport time: The sheet needs the principle, two evidence items, open questions and module handoff.

knowledge.title: 搬運時間拆解的原理
knowledge.text: 等待、行車、升降與交握各有不同改善途徑。
knowledge.textEn: Queueing, travel, hoisting and handshakes need different remedies.

knowledge.title: 本階段的機制與工程權衡
knowledge.text: 晶圓製程會反覆回到同類設備，搬運需求因此是有回路的網路問題，而非單向生產線的距離最小化。
knowledge.textEn: Wafers revisit equipment types, making transport a reentrant network problem rather than one-way line-distance minimization.

quiz.question: 評估「搬運時間拆解」時，哪項敘述可以採用？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is valid when evaluating decompose transport time?
options: 平均車速較快就保證所有任務延遲下降。
交握超時就代表載具尚未移動。
等待、行車、升降與交握各有不同改善途徑。
optionsEn: Higher mean speed guarantees lower delay for every task.
Handshake timeout means the carrier has not moved.
Queueing, travel, hoisting and handshakes need different remedies.
quiz.explanation: 等待、行車、升降與交握各有不同改善途徑。 晶圓製程會反覆回到同類設備，搬運需求因此是有回路的網路問題，而非單向生產線的距離最小化。
quiz.explanationEn: Queueing, travel, hoisting and handshakes need different remedies. Wafers revisit equipment types, making transport a reentrant network problem rather than one-way line-distance minimization.
